newsitem.title: USA: Checkpoint adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Checkpoint adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Checkpoint Systems Inc said Thursday that, effective March 10, it adopted a new shareholders rights plan covering the next 10 years and has simultaneously terminated the prior shareholders rights plan, which was adopted in December 1988.
The company said it will redeem the rights issued under the 1988 plan to holders as of the close of business on March 24, 1997 and pay a redemption price of $0.005 per right on April 8, 1997.
Under the new plan, the exercise price of each right has been set at $100, the company said.
"The board's action is not in response to any known effort to acquire a controlling interest in Checkpoint," Chairman A.E. Wolf said in a statement issued by the company.
The company said the prior plan was due to expire next year.
The company said the prior plan's exercise price, compared with the company's common stock market price, was out of balance.
